defaults.reader: Someone involved in a morning portrait session at a public forest preserve
defaults.job: Understand the plan for the morning well enough to act on it
precisionLocks: locations and how to reach them
rules the reader is bound by

surfaces.name: client-brief
surfaces.reader: A parent of three young children, reading this on a phone the night before while getting kids to bed
surfaces.job: Know where to meet, when, what to wear and bring, and roughly what the morning will feel like — without needing to ask a follow-up question at 6am
precisionLocks: the meeting time and the arrival buffer before it
each location name and how to find it from the parking area
what to wear on their feet and what to bring for the children
the leash rule, if a dog is coming
that the mansion interior is not part of the session
the phone number to reach on the morning itself

denyTerms.reason: Trade shorthand a parent has no reason to know
denyTerms.replacement: the first hour of soft morning light

denyTerms.reason: Turns their child into an object of the process
Describes the lens, not anything the family experiences or decides
denyTerms.replacement: cut it — say where you will be standing if it matters

denyTerms.reason: Names an internal workflow stage rather than what happens
denyTerms.replacement: smaller groups — just the girls, just the two of you

denyTerms.reason: Sounds like a procedure being run on them
Operator-side permit classification with no bearing on the family's morning

surfaces.name: operator-playbook
surfaces.reader: The photographer on site between 7:00 and 9:15am, glancing at a phone between frames while three children lose patience
surfaces.job: Move through the three locations on schedule with the right lens and settings, and tell at a glance which access and permit claims were checked at a source and which are still assumptions
assumedKnowledge: Focal lengths, apertures, shutter speeds, and their tradeoffs
Sony a7 V menu structure and autofocus terminology
precisionLocks: the three time blocks and the order of locations
permit fees, insurance minimums, and application lead times — each with its source and the date it was checked
preserve access hours and site conduct rules — each with its source and the date it was checked
whether this session's classification actually exempts it from the permit, and on what published basis
Sony a7 V menu paths worded exactly as the camera labels them
aperture, shutter, and ISO floors, with the reason each floor exists
allowTerms: Forest Preserve District of DuPage County

denyTerms.reason: The permit and access claims in the source brief were never pulled at a source; writing verified makes an assumption actionable
Same failure as verified, one synonym further from the source
The permit question is exactly where this phrasing costs a shoot
denyTerms.replacement: the published rule and where it is published, or an explicit unverified

denyTerms.reason: Appeals to a consensus no preserve district publishes
denyTerms.replacement: the district's own rule, with source and check date

denyTerms.reason: Generalizes past this district and this camera body
denyTerms.replacement: what this preserve or this body specifies
